systems.owner: Centre National de Traitement des Données Electorales (CNTDE), ministry in charge of elections, supervised by the CENI
systems.tiers: national; computerised and centralised by law, one list per polling station

note: The electoral code, articles 1-13: communes are named only as bodies whose elections it governs; the voter file is a central ministry system; a law, and nothing on communes' connection.
